text.en: You just have to multiply the two 4-bit numbers; the result fits naturally in 8 bits and there's no clock at all.
text.es: Sólo tienes que multiplicar los dos números de 4 bits; el resultado cabe de forma natural en 8 bits y no hay reloj en absoluto.

text.en: With `IEEE.NUMERIC_STD`, cast both inputs to `unsigned`, use the overloaded `*` operator, and cast the 8-bit product back to `std_logic_vector` in a single concurrent assignment.
text.es: Con `IEEE.NUMERIC_STD`, convierte ambas entradas a `unsigned`, usa el operador `*` sobrecargado y devuelve el producto de 8 bits a `std_logic_vector` en una sola asignación concurrente.

text.en:
No resizing needed: `unsigned(3 downto 0) * unsigned(3 downto 0)` is already exactly 8 bits wide.
```vhdl
product <= std_logic_vector(unsigned(a) * unsigned(b));
```
text.es:
No hace falta redimensionar: `unsigned(3 downto 0) * unsigned(3 downto 0)` ya da 8 bits exactos.
```vhdl
product <= std_logic_vector(unsigned(a) * unsigned(b));
```
